title: Add token-sparkline panel and adaptive alert silence policy
author: Sophie Patel
release_notes: Added a lightweight per-invocation token-sparkline dashboard panel and an adaptive alert-silence policy that reduces noisy low-impact token-cost alerts. Includes OTEL span enrichment for token_phase and token_count labels. Backwards-compatible
description:
Motivation: long-tail token-cost and micro-latency spikes generate high alert churn for oncall teams even when impact is economically negligible. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: (1) a lightweight 'token-spark' dashboard panel (Grafana + pre-aggregated microbuckets) that surfaces per-invocation token cost and latency sparklines alongside SLO anchors, and (2) an adaptive silence policy for cost/latency alerts that suppresses alerts below a dynamic noise floor computed from recent burstiness.

What this changes (high level):
- New Grafana panel definition: console/dashboards/token_sparkline.json (supports 10-sample micro-sparklines per invocation).
- New alerting adapter: observability/alerts/adaptive_silence.py which calculates per-route noise-floor and gate thresholds and emits suppression decisions as events.
- OTEL span enrichment: observability/telemetry/otel_enrichment.go adds span attributes token_count and token_phase and maps token microbucket vectors into span metadata for downstream rollups.
- Frontend shim: sdk/typescript/src/ui/Sparkline.tsx renders compact sparklines and exposes an on-hover cost breakdown popover.
- Docs and runbook: docs/observability/token-sparkline.md and runbook links in alert definitions.
- Tests: tests/integration/test_adaptive_silence.py + unit tests for the enrichment hooks.

- observability/telemetry/otel_enrichment.go
- sdk/typescript/src/ui/Sparkline.tsx

- charts/grafana/token-sparkline-panel.yaml

Operational notes:
- The adaptive silence algorithm computes a per-route noise_floor = baseline + alpha * EWMA(recent_token_burst_std). Alerts with estimated token-cost impact < noise_floor are marked suppressed; larger incidents are allowed through. Default alpha tuned to 1.5 in tests, can be tuned via console.
- OTEL enrichment adds token_phase and token_count attributes to invocation spans; this increases span size modestly (approx +120 bytes/span observed in canary). We added a config flag to disable enrichment for low-memory collectors.
- Grafana panel uses a compact pre-aggregated microbucket vector emitted by the metrics rollup (bucket_0..bucket_9). The panel decodes buckets into a 10-point sparkline per invocation row.

Backward compatibility and rollout:
- Feature-flagged rollout: otel enrichment and alert adapter behind feature flags; default off for all production tenants for first week post-merge.
- Console includes a toggle under Observability -> Alerts -> "Adaptive Silence" with per-tenant override.

Related work: ENG-4982 (design), ENG-5021 (canary harness), PRs: #712345 (prefetch warmup oscillation autotune) for common telemetry helpers.
